ledger.note: 1 January 1986: Aruba leaves the Netherlands Antilles and becomes a separate country within the Kingdom of the Netherlands ('status aparte'). 'On 1 January 1986' Aruba seceded from the Netherlands Antilles (Aruba page); infobox 'Country status: 1 January 1986'. The Dissolution page adds that it did so 'on the condition that it would become fully independent in 1996'; the Netherlands and Aruba agreed in July 1990 to delete that article (finalised 1994 on the Dissolution page, 1995 on the Aruba page). The netherlands-antilles ledger 16 records the loss on the same day.

notes: Written by n-mod from two pages. TYPE: colony of netherlands (a constituent country of the Kingdom, not sovereign; the orchestrator's note says the patch draws the cell as Dutch land). If the project prefers a state of its own colour, change type to state and add a vassal_start in the netherlands ledger. END 2026 = current year (alive today); no dissolve. Pre-1986 history of the island (Spanish c. 1500, Dutch from 1636, British 1806-1816, the 1940 French occupation) is in netherlands-antilles ledger 1, not here; the Aruba page dates the 1977 referendum (82 per cent for independence) and the 1983 agreement within the Kingdom. The cell is the 1 January 1986 loss of netherlands-antilles; from 2010 the Antilles dissolves.
